decision.reason: [ev-2349d1c09109] only states the metric rename; it names no component, flag or configuration that causes the metric to be emitted, so the proposed exposure cli-flag `--metrics` set on cilium-agent is an unsupported guess and would be broader than the environments that actually emit or consume this metric. The same section also contradicts itself on the new name ([ev-d6005e84dee9] says `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total`, [ev-2349d1c09109] says `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`; likewise [ev-eaf366d94d17] vs [ev-7ede52ce8bb8]). Missing: which component emits the doublewrite metrics and under what configuration they are enabled, plus which rename target is correct for 1.17.0; consumption by dashboards/alerts is otherwise external runtime state.
